title: Performance rules
description: Budget and asset rules: bundle size, images, inline data and heavy imports.

rules.title: Initial JavaScript gzip size over the absolute budget
rules.message: The initial JavaScript bundle is over its gzip budget.
rules.fix: Split the entry, lazy-load routes, or remove dependencies.
rules.rationale: Initial JavaScript is the largest cost of first load.

rules.title: Initial CSS gzip size over the absolute budget
rules.message: The initial CSS bundle is over its gzip budget.
rules.fix: Remove unused styles or split critical CSS.

rules.title: Bundle growth over the allowed increase
rules.message: The initial bundle grew by more than the allowed amount since the baseline.
rules.fix: Find what grew, or have a human record a new baseline.
rules.rationale: Small increases accumulate unnoticed unless each change is bounded.

rules.title: img without width and height
rules.message: An image has no intrinsic size and no aspect ratio, so it shifts the layout when it loads.
rules.fix: Set width and height, or reserve space with an aspect-ratio class or style.

rules.title: Image asset over the size or width budget
rules.message: An image is larger than the image budget.
rules.fix: Resize or compress it, or serve responsive variants.

rules.title: Inline data URI over 4 KiB
rules.message: A large data: URI is inlined in code.
rules.fix: Move the asset to a file so it can be cached and compressed.
rules.rationale: Inline blobs inflate bundles and bypass caching.

rules.title: Import of a heavy library root
rules.message: A heavy library is imported from its root entry.
rules.fix: Import the specific function (lodash/debounce) or use a lighter alternative.
rules.rationale: Root imports can pull the whole library into the bundle.
